protocol.scope: The unchanged original72 method/version cohort; fresh method-level generation for all five tools.
protocol.selection: Freeze all72 old exploratory core methods before observing this batch. Prior selection is post hoc and concentrated in two classes; keep all failures and zero coverage.
protocol.original_method_manifest_membership: Original72 exploratory sample; no published-tool dataset membership claim.
protocol.budgets: Common wall ceiling; native search, symbolic and repair budgets differ and are reported, not equated.
protocol.llm_cache: Fresh per-method/tool caches; provider cache usage recorded separately.
protocol.java: EvoSuite JDK8; other tools JDK17; compatibility limitation retained
protocol.primary_coverage: Exact public focal JVM method; common immutable JaCoCo denominator; zero/failure outcomes retained.
protocol.wrapper_policy: Every frozen method retained; old descriptive groups recorded for audit only.
protocol.cost: Actual per-attempt provider usage including retries; failed/cancelled client requests counted when usage available.
protocol.result_policy: Preserve zero/timeout/generation failure; no outcome-based sample exclusions.

tools_provenance.HITS: third-party reproduction with safe lexical name repair

protocol.old_results: Read-only; no old class-level or341 results substituted into this fresh batch.
protocol.old_results_policy: All360 method/tool cells receive fresh generation and measurement.
protocol.output_cases: Generated Java source cases, discovered/executed JUnit cases and compile success recorded separately; no focal-hit claim from case counts alone.
